we have shown that, under the most extreme mis-specification of the short run dynamics, the four parametric estimators of the long run dynamics are asymptotically equivalent.

the asymptotic distributional results are robust to a wide class of short run misspecification, and that the estimators are relatively well-behaved in finite samples, even in the case of severe short run misspecifications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
mis-specified estimations of the short run dynamics can be used to produce valid inferences about the long memory parameter.
